title: Common
description: Small shared types used by every other schema file.

ProtocolVersion.description: Version of these schemas. Bump it on every breaking change; see protocol/README.md.

Uuid.description: A UUID in its canonical text form.

DeviceId.description: Stable id of a paired device, created at pairing.

Timestamp.description: An ISO 8601 date and time with a time zone, for example 2026-10-09T15:42:00+08:00.

Path.description: An exact file path, absolute or starting with ~/. The wildcard characters * and ? are rejected (SPEC-07 r8); brackets and braces are allowed because they are common in real file names.

RouteReason.description: Why the router picked a lane, shown on the dashboard (SPEC-03 r10).

PermissionLevel.description: Decided by the harness for every action, never by the model (SPEC-07 r1).

ResultStatus.description: Outcome of a subtask attempt (SPEC-05 r4).

StepOutcome.description: What happened when a step ran.
